questions.question: Which fraction is equivalent to 1/2?
questions.answer_explanation: Two fourths covers the same amount as one half.

questions.question: Which fraction represents the 4th equal part out of 7 on a number line from 0 to 1?
questions.answer_explanation: After 4 equal steps of size 1/7, the point is 4/7.

questions.question: A whole is divided into 6 equal parts. What fraction names one of those parts?
questions.answer_explanation: One equal part out of 6 is the unit fraction 1/6.

questions.question: Which shape has four equal sides and four right angles?
questions.answer_explanation: A square has four equal sides and four right angles.

questions.question: A line plot shows 3 students at 4 inches and 2 students at 5 inches. How many students are shown?
questions.answer_explanation: There are 3 + 2 = 5 students.

questions.question: A pictograph shows 1 picture = 2 books. If there are 5 pictures, how many books are shown?
questions.answer_explanation: Each picture represents 2 books, so 5 × 2 = 10.

questions.question: A rectangle is 5 units long and 3 units wide. What is its perimeter?
questions.answer_explanation: Perimeter = 5 + 3 + 5 + 3 = 16 units.

questions.question: A rectangle is 6 units long and 3 units wide. What is its area?
questions.answer_explanation: Area = length × width = 6 × 3 = 18 square units.

questions.question: A rectangle is covered by 4 rows of 5 unit squares. What is its area?
questions.answer_explanation: Area is the number of unit squares: 4 × 5 = 20.

questions.question: Which unit is most appropriate for measuring the amount of water in a large bottle?
questions.answer_explanation: Liters are used to measure liquid volume.

questions.question: A movie starts at 2:00 and lasts 1 hour. When does it end?
questions.answer_explanation: One hour after 2:00 is 3:00.

questions.question: Which division fact belongs to the same fact family as 6 × 5 = 30?
questions.answer_explanation: Multiplication and division are inverse operations: 30 ÷ 6 = 5.
